name: What maintenance is required for glass partitions?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for glass partitions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Glass partitions require relatively low maintenance, primarily involving regular cleaning to keep them looking clear and professional. This typically means wiping down glass surfaces with a non-abrasive cleaner and a soft cloth to prevent streaks and smudges. For framed systems, occasional checks of seals and hardware ensure longevity and proper function. Hometelligent Inc. recommends establishing a routine cleaning schedule to maintain the aesthetic appeal and structural integrity of your installed partitions, especially in high-traffic commercial environments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance is low, mainly regular cleaning with non-abrasive cleaner. Occasional checks of seals and hardware are recommended for framed systems.
